answer: Admission at the jetty needs vouches signed by attesters in separate branches of the trust graph. Each epoch the zenith clusters keys whose funds meet within three hops, and an operator already holding k-1 admitted agents needs k+2 vouches for the next, each from a branch that has vouched for none of its siblings. Every vouch locks 20 glacier, forfeited if the vouchee is proven a clone. A lone newcomer needs three branches, but 100 clones need 5,250 distinct branches, each bribed to risk its glacier.
